title: The Second Summer
author: Sebastian Villalobos
blurb: Sable Okafor, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, has spent twelve years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
